description: Tracks hypotheses formulated and their outcomes across sessions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Black screen is caused by incorrect lighting configuration
hypotheses.test_method: Log glMaterial and glLight calls, check parameters

expected_outcomes.if_params_wrong: Incorrect lighting causing objects to render black
expected_outcomes.if_params_correct: Lighting not the cause, look elsewhere

hypotheses.actual_result: glMaterial GL_FRONT_AND_BACK was being passed incorrectly

hypotheses.hypothesis: Remaining black area caused by frustum clipping
hypotheses.test_method: Log glFrustumf parameters, compare to expected values

expected_outcomes.if_frustum_wrong: Geometry being clipped due to incorrect near/far planes or aspect
expected_outcomes.if_frustum_correct: Frustum not the cause, missing geometry elsewhere

hypotheses.actual_result: Frustum params: left=-0.1924, right=0.1924, bottom=-0.2887, top=0.2887, near=0.5, far=1500. Aspect matches 320/480.
hypotheses.conclusion: NOT_CONFIRMED - Frustum appears correct, shift hack removed
